newsitem.title: USA: 3Com reports higher first quarter profits.
newsitem.headline: 3Com reports higher first quarter profits.

text.p: 3Com Corp. Tuesday reported sharply higher profits for the first quarter of fiscal 1997, led by strong sales of its systems products.
The maker of computer networking products earned $93.1 million in the three months ended in August, up 62 percent from the year ago profit of $57.4 million.
Earnings per share jumped 58 percent to 52 cents from 33 cents a year ago. The results were better than analysts' estimates of 47 cents a share, sending shares of 3Com higher in after hours trade.
According to the Reuters Instinet System, 3Com was up $2.125 to $58.75 in after-hours trade. Earlier, the stock slipped 37.5 cents to $56.75.
3Com said sales for the quarter ended August 31 totalled $707 million, an increase of 42 percent from the first quarter of fiscal 1996.
Sales of systems products, which includes switches, hubs, and internetworking platforms rose 38 percent to $416.4 million while sales of network adapters rose 52 percent to $283.3 million.
